top_signals.title: Economists See RBA Hike as Early as September After Hot CPI
top_signals.summary: Australia’s hot inflation spurred economists from Goldman Sachs Group Inc. to Commonwealth Bank to predict another interest-rate increase as early as next month, abandoning expectations of no change for the remainder of the year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

Installation of 35-Ton Propeller Sets the Stage for SMM 2026
top_signals.summary: The giant ship propeller supplied by Mecklenburger Metallguss (MMG) will once again take its place in front of the Hamburg exhibition halls. On Thursday, August 27, the maritime heavyweight will return to the exhibition grounds, providing a visible signal that SMM 2026 is about to begin.
